description: Source code for WiFi CSI (Channel State Information) analytics, including initialization, data processing, bus communication, threading, and event handling.
external_files: <system headers like errno.h, fcntl.h, pthread.h, stdbool.h, stdint.h, stdio.h, string.h, sys/time.h>

methods.name: get_wifi_app_obj
methods.description: Retrieves the WiFi application object for a given instance.

methods.name: add_new_hash_map_entry
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new CSI analytics data entry into the hash map.

methods.name: set_bus_csi_sta_maclist
methods.description: Sets the station MAC list in the bus for CSI analytics.

methods.name: mac_exists_in_list
methods.description: Checks if a MAC address exists in the total MAC list string.

methods.name: add_str_mac_addr
methods.description: Adds a MAC address to the total MAC list string if not already present.

methods.name: process_csi_analytics_data
methods.description: Processes incoming CSI data, updates hash map, and manages MAC list.

methods.name: run_bus_csi_sta_maclist
methods.description: Timer callback to update the MAC list in the bus.

methods.name: update_mac_list
methods.description: Updates the MAC list string and schedules MAC list update timer.

methods.name: webconfig_hal_csi_data_apply
methods.description: Applies new CSI configuration data from web configuration.

methods.name: webconfig_set_data_event
methods.description: Handles web configuration events for setting CSI data.

methods.name: csi_analytics_webconfig_events
methods.description: Dispatches web configuration events related to CSI analytics.

methods.name: csi_analytics_event
methods.description: Main event handler for CSI analytics events.

methods.name: set_bus_csi_sub_enable_status
methods.description: Sets the enable/disable status of CSI collection in the bus.

methods.name: run_bus_csi_enable_status
methods.description: Timer callback to update CSI enable status in the bus.

methods.name: run_csi_enable_timer
methods.description: Starts a timer to update CSI enable status.

methods.name: do_nothing_handler
methods.description: Placeholder event handler that does nothing.

methods.name: clean_all_csi_analytics_data
methods.description: Cleans up all CSI analytics data and resources.

methods.name: csi_analytics_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the CSI analytics application, releases resources.

methods.name: decode_csi_pipe_msg
methods.description: Decodes CSI data message received from pipe.

methods.name: pipe_read_oper_thread_func
methods.description: Thread function to read CSI data from FIFO pipe and process it.

methods.name: csi_analytics_bus_subscription
methods.description: Subscribes to bus events for CSI analytics.

methods.name: init_bus_subscription
methods.description: Initializes bus communication and subscriptions for CSI analytics.

methods.name: open_csi_data_connection
methods.description: Creates a thread to read CSI data from FIFO pipe.

methods.name: csi_analytics_init
methods.description: Initializes CSI analytics application, sets up bus, threading, and hash map.

methods.name: csi_analytics_update
methods.description: Updates CSI analytics application state based on configuration.
